name: Houkago no Tokubetsu Jugyou
source:
Main character is left for supplementary classes for some reason. Female teachers is in charge of this training. With the two of them in the room even breath is felt. Woman is dressed suggestively, but she does not feel responsible. Teacher, what are you doing?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不知出于什么原因，主人公被留下来补课，负责辅导他的是一名女教师。房间里只有两人，彼此甚至能感受到对方的呼吸。女教师穿得格外撩人，自己却毫无自觉。

老师，你到底在做什么？

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
